_about: Valencious runes for scripts/region1/rune_gesture.gd. Straight strokes and sharp corners, like the glowing runes on the road stones. Coordinates are a unit square, x right, y down. A glyph has 1 to 3 strokes; the recognizer accepts any stroke order and direction, any rotation and size.

recognizer._note: points per shape; min_size in input units (px) below which a scribble is ignored; min_sim is the cosine similarity needed (1 = perfect); min_margin is the lead over the next different glyph; confidence maps sim from confidence_floor..1 to 0..1; fast_accept skips the other stroke counts when the same-count best is this good; max_rotation_deg 180 = any rotation.

glyphs.name: Ward
glyphs.meaning: Hold the line: a wide, strong bubble that keeps monsters out.
glyphs.hint: One stroke: a diamond. Start anywhere, come back to the start.

glyphs.name: Lure
glyphs.meaning: Come here: the stone stops warding and calls the pack to this spot.
glyphs.hint: Two strokes: an arrowhead, then the shaft through its tip.

glyphs.name: Alarm
glyphs.meaning: Wake the village: the stone rings when a threat comes near.
glyphs.hint: One stroke: a lightning zigzag, down-left, across, down-left.

glyphs.name: Bless
glyphs.meaning: Bless the harvest: crops around the stone grow richer.
glyphs.hint: Two strokes: a cross, corner to corner.
